annotations.title: Weather forecast for an exact spot

description: Day-by-day weather (up to 16 days) for an exact location and elevation, more accurate than a single-model app: every major model (ECMWF, NOAA NBM/GFS/HRRR, UK Met Office, ICON, GEM, Meteo-France, JMA) run at the spot's own elevation, corrected for each model's recent error at the nearest weather stations, blended by recent accuracy, with rain, snow and temperature-range probabilities from 82 ensemble members. Each day also shows what a typical weather app says, for comparison.

elevationFt.description: Elevation of the exact spot in feet, if known (else from a 90 m terrain map).

location.description: 'lat,lon' (most precise), a place ('Moab, UT', 'Chamonix'), or a Veabird ski resort name.

spot.description: At a ski resort: the base (default) or the summit.

units.description: us (°F, in, mph; default) or metric.

name: point_forecast
